text: interp.rs nest_cost (wasm32 only): check_closure_param_refines gets its own nest_guard and CHECK_CLOSURE_PARAM_REFINES(_SEALED) budget, so only a call to a closure with a refined parameter pays its frame; CALL_CLOSURE_FRAME(_SEALED) and FINISH_CALL_COLD raised to the frames wasm_stack_budget.py measures. nest_guard compiles to nothing off wasm32; no evaluator change on native or interpreter runs.
